description_sq:
Shesim apartament 1+1 tek kompleksi Urban Gate .
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 2-te te nje pallati shume cilesor me ashensor dhe ka siperfaqje totale 70m2.
Organizimi eshte i rregullt me korridor qe ben shperndarjen ne dhomen e ndenjes & kuzhine, nje dhome gjumi, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon.
Ka orientim te favorshem per ndricim natyral gjate dites.
Apartamenti eshte i investuar ne menyre cilesore.
Per me teper informacion apo vizite ne prone, me kontaktoni.
description_en: We are selling a 1+1 apartment in the Urban Gate complex. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a high-quality building with an elevator and has a total area of ​​70m2. The organization is regular with a corridor that divides the living room & kitchen, a bedroom, a toilet and a balcony. It has a favorable orientation for natural lighting during the day. The apartment is invested in a quality way. For more information or a visit to the property, contact me.
